name: Domonic Williams Jr.
strengths: Williams undercuts the quick out, takes the interception in stride, and scores.
Williams triggers downhill, squares the runner, and forces the fumble.
Williams chases from the backside and saves the touchdown with closing speed.
Williams gets his head around on the vertical and plays the ball instead of the back.
weaknesses: Williams will guess and undercut the short route — double moves will punish that if he does not stay in phase, and the backpedal still gathers before he turns.
comparison: Williams comps to Trent McDuffie — 5-11 / 193 compact press/man corner with twitch, physicality, and the same downhill strike.
projection: Williams projects as a Year 1 special-teams / nickel corner, then a Year 2 rotation piece, with Year 3 starter upside if he stays in phase on the double move.
schemeFit: Williams fits a physical perimeter CB who can jump the short throw and still run the vertical.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-09-23 from Jacksonville (NC) sophomore reel (embed 23135595 / 694b0fbfe973529892f84416). First Gainesville trip, Ole Miss weekend. Comp height-matched at 5-11 — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Domonic Williams Jr. is a 2028 CB · listed 5-11 / 185 · Jacksonville (Jacksonville, NC) · first Gainesville trip set for Ole Miss weekend. Expected / planning, not confirmed on campus.
angle: Lead with the pick-six on the out and the fumble-forcing tackle; Williams is a physical corner.
insiderNotes: Williams is a compact 5-11 / 185 corner who undercuts the out, scores, and still chases a breakaway down from behind. He triggers downhill and forces the fumble. He will jump the short throw — double moves will punish that if he does not stay in phase.
